name: login-01
title: Sign in
description: A centred sign-in card: email, password, remember me and a second sign-in option.

name: login-02
title: Sign in, split screen
description: The form on one side and your brand and a customer quote on the other. Stacks on phones.

name: signup-01
title: Create account
description: Name, email and password with a hint, a terms checkbox and a link back to sign in.

name: forgot-password-01
title: Reset password
description: Ask for the email address, send a reset link, and say what happens next.

name: dashboard-01
title: Dashboard
description: An app screen: side navigation, stat cards, a stacked area chart, recent sales and an orders table.

name: stats-01
title: Stat cards
description: Four key numbers with a trend badge each. They wrap from four across to one.

name: settings-01
title: Profile settings
description: Profile fields, a bio, notification switches and Save and Cancel buttons.

name: team-01
title: Team members
description: Invite by email, then list people with their role in a select.

name: hero-01
title: Hero
description: A centred headline with a badge, a lead paragraph and two calls to action.

name: pricing-01
title: Pricing
description: Three plans with feature lists; the middle one is highlighted as the most popular.

name: faq-01
title: FAQ
description: Questions in an accordion next to a short intro and a contact link.

name: contact-01
title: Contact
description: A contact form with a topic select, next to your email, phone and address.

name: error-01
title: Page not found
description: A friendly 404 with a way back home and a link to search.
